notes: Synthetic born-digital fixture rendered via LibreOffice (a producer Memex's classifier recognizes) by generate.py — see CITATION.md for the independence rationale. RENDERER NOTE: an earlier PyMuPDF `Story` render was non-representative (pymupdf4llm dropped the first paragraph after some headings, a Story artifact); the LibreOffice render resolves that — those paragraphs parse correctly, which answered the 'does pymupdf4llm drop post-heading paragraphs on real born-digital PDFs?' question (no, only on Story-rendered ones). Remaining REAL findings the parse surfaces: (1) all heading levels flatten to H2 (the H1 title + the H3 checklist both become `##`) and headings are `**bold**`-wrapped — caps structural-F1; (2) the HTML table flattens (the writerweb HTML->ODT filter loses table borders, so pymupdf4llm reads the header row as a spurious `## Date Visibility Notes` heading + the rows as flat text) — a clean GFM-table fixture needs a word-processor-authored table, a future curator item. Thresholds are REGRESSION gates calibrated to the measured baseline + margin (passes today, alerts on regression). Aspirational modern-print target is CER <= 0.02; the residual here is heading-level flattening + table flattening + bold markers, not text loss.
